passages.account-key: Rotate a personal provider key from Account settings. Replace the key, save it, and retry the failed conversation. Rotating the key does not delete conversation history.
passages.project-key: A workspace administrator manages the provider connection used by project chats. Personal account keys do not override that project connection.
passages.failed-job: A failed background task keeps its last successful output. Open the task, inspect the failure, correct the input and retry the task.
passages.cancel-job: Cancel a running task to stop further work. Cancelling is different from retrying a failed task and does not produce a new output.
passages.budget-exhausted: When a project's credit budget is exhausted, new model requests are blocked. The administrator can increase the budget or wait for its scheduled renewal.
passages.budget-warning: A budget warning alerts the administrator that spending is close to the limit. Requests continue until the budget is exhausted.
passages.private-file: Only project members with access to a source file can retrieve its passages. Search results must respect source permissions even if a vector index contains the file.
passages.public-file: Published reference documents can be searched by readers who have access to the published collection. Publication does not make private project files public.
passages.delete-source: Removing a source marks its passages as deleted and schedules vector cleanup. Deleted passages must stop appearing in retrieval results immediately.
passages.archive-chat: Archive a chat to hide it from the active chat list. Archiving a chat does not delete its attached source documents or remove their vectors.
passages.release-current: Release note dated 2026-09-15: project exports now include task attachments. This replaces the earlier export limitation announced in June.
passages.release-old: Release note dated 2026-06-01: project exports omit task attachments. This limitation applied before the September export update.
passages.retry-code: async function retryOnce(operation) { try { return await operation(); } catch { return await operation(); } } This function makes at most two attempts and propagates the second failure.
passages.poll-code: async function poll(status) { while ((await status()) === 'pending') { await delay(1000); } } This waits for completion but does not retry a failed operation.
passages.scope-code: const record = await repository.findById(id); if (!record || record.ownerId !== user.id) throw forbidden(); return record; This checks ownership before returning a private record.
passages.unscoped-code: const record = await repository.findById(id); return record; This example omits the ownership check and must not be used for private records.
passages.vector-space: Vectors generated by different embedding models cannot be compared directly, even when both models return 1024 numbers. Keep model, dimensions, task mode and vector-space version with each indexed document.
passages.vector-store: Vectorize and S3 Vectors store and search numeric embeddings. Selecting a vector store does not determine which embedding model generated a vector.
passages.file-table: Invoice summary extracted from a PDF: Project Alder, invoice INV-1042, total GBP 480, due 14 October 2026. Project Birch, invoice INV-1043, total GBP 840, due 21 October 2026.
passages.file-other: Invoice summary extracted from a PDF: Project Cedar, invoice INV-2042, total GBP 480, due 14 November 2026. Project Elm, invoice INV-2043, total GBP 840, due 21 November 2026.
passages.meeting-action: Planning meeting: Mira owns the retrieval evaluation and will share results on Friday. Arun owns the export fix. The team agreed to keep the current embedding model until quality measurements are available.
passages.meeting-distractor: Planning meeting: Mira reviewed the export fix on Monday. Arun shared the retrieval design. No embedding quality results were presented at this meeting.
passages.french-archive: Pour retrouver une conversation archivée, ouvrez la liste des archives et restaurez la conversation. La restauration ne recrée pas les documents supprimés.
passages.spanish-budget: Si se agota el presupuesto del proyecto, las solicitudes nuevas se bloquean. El administrador puede aumentar el presupuesto o esperar a que se renueve.
